en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3663 - It is narrated from Abu al-Maghra, who said:

A man asked Abu Abdullah (as), while I was present, 'May Allah (swt) rectify your affairs. I pass by the official or go to the official, and he grants me dirhams. Should I take them?'
Imam (as) said: 'Yes.'

I asked: 'Can I perform Hajj with them?'
Imam (as) said: 'Yes, and perform Hajj with them.'
